The Beetle (or The Beetle: A Mystery) is an 1897 fin de siècle Gothic horror novel by British writer Richard Marsh, in which a shape-shifting ancient Egyptian entity seeks revenge on a British member of Parliament. The novel initially sold more copies than Bram Stoker's Dracula, a similar supernatural horror story published in the same year.
